campaign.title: Apply the host-authorized numeric edits for sequential_override.

initial.code:
FUNCTION CASE005_CREDIT_RENAMED(X)
  CASE005_CREDIT_RENAMED = 0
  IF (X >= 0) THEN
    CASE005_CREDIT_RENAMED = 1
  END IF
  CASE005_CREDIT_RENAMED = CASE005_CREDIT_RENAMED
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION CASE005_MINOR(X)
  CASE005_MINOR = 0
  IF (X < 26) THEN
    CASE005_MINOR = 1
  END IF
  CASE005_MINOR = CASE005_MINOR
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION CASE005_ELIGIBLE(X)
  CASE005_ELIGIBLE = 0
  IF (CASE005_CREDIT_RENAMED(X) >= 1) THEN
    CASE005_ELIGIBLE = 1
  END IF
  IF (CASE005_MINOR(X) >= 1) THEN
    CASE005_ELIGIBLE = 0
  END IF
  CASE005_ELIGIBLE = CASE005_ELIGIBLE
END FUNCTION
